title: 恒隆陈文博：奢侈品销售企稳，内地住宅市场需数年消化？
speaker: Adriel Chan

segments.en: Luxury has performed decently. If you look at the LVMH and the carrying numbers, they have also basically shown what we've been seeing as well, which is that stabilization no longer falling.
segments.zh: 奢侈品表现不错。从LVMH等公司的数据看，也印证了我们看到的趋势——市场企稳，不再下滑。

segments.en: But I think the luxury brands are still very conservative. We're still cautious. Consumer sentiment overall is still cautious. But what we're seeing in our sales numbers is that there's actually growth. So retail sales are OK. Foot traffic is at an all-time high. So there is this kind of bifurcation between sentiment and reality.
segments.zh: 但奢侈品牌仍非常保守，我们依然谨慎，消费者情绪总体谨慎。但我们的销售数据显示实际在增长，零售销售尚可，客流量创历史新高。情绪与现实之间存在分化。

segments.en: The hope is that we won't, of course. We'd rather do these things once, rather than multiple times, same with anything along the lines of dividend cuts or bad news is always better done once, rather than multiple times. But on that point, I think the China residential market it's going to be quiet for some time.
segments.zh: 当然希望不会。我们宁愿一次性处理，而不是多次。同样，削减股息等坏消息最好一次完成。但内地住宅市场将沉寂一段时间。

segments.en: But if you start looking at those leading numbers, completions, and also actually starts, new starts, and the inventory that may be in the pipeline, it's looking like it's extremely low, perhaps even lower than the expected baseline. And so in a few years time, who knows where that'll lead us?
segments.zh: 但若看领先指标，如竣工量、新开工量以及潜在库存，似乎极低，甚至低于预期基线。几年后，谁知道会走向何方？
